structured_output.content: The release note only says that v1.18.0 adds support for the ACME profiles extension (#7777). It doesn't say whether this changes existing behaviour or which resource fields it adds. The environment does use cert-manager (v1.17.0) and the `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` apiVersion. However, the manifests contain no Issuer or ClusterIssuer, the only installed CRD listed is `certificates.cert-manager.io`, and the CRD dimension is marked absent, so I can't tell whether any ACME issuer is configured. To settle this, check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses ACME, then read PR #7777 to see whether the feature is opt-in or changes how existing ACME issuers behave.
